Review a PR by URL

Use a URL from either documentation repository, including closed PRs.

Includes all open PRs, including drafts, ordered by most recently updated. Review uses chat credits and verifies a pinned revision, not this list's cached metadata.

Review opens an unsubmitted /pr-review <PR link> draft in a new chat, followed by any instructions you entered. Choose your chat options and send when ready. No PR checkout, execution, article edits, or GitHub comments. Results stay in chat; launching does not track completion or populate batch Findings. Check Chat before retrying a failed handoff.
